SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '') AS c_last_name,
        CASE WHEN c.c_last_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c_last_name_null,
        COALESCE(c.c_first_name, '') AS c_first_name,
        CASE WHEN c.c_first_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c_first_name_null,
        COALESCE(dd.d_date, DATE '1900-01-01') AS d_date,
        CASE WHEN dd.d_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS d_date_null
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer AS c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),
        CASE WHEN c.c_last_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
        CASE WHEN c.c_first_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        COALESCE(dd.d_date, DATE '1900-01-01'),
        CASE WHEN dd.d_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) AS s
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '') AS c_last_name,
        CASE WHEN c.c_last_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c_last_name_null,
        COALESCE(c.c_first_name, '') AS c_first_name,
        CASE WHEN c.c_first_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c_first_name_null,
        COALESCE(dd.d_date, DATE '1900-01-01') AS d_date,
        CASE WHEN dd.d_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS d_date_null
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim AS dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer AS c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),
        CASE WHEN c.c_last_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
        CASE WHEN c.c_first_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        COALESCE(dd.d_date, DATE '1900-01-01'),
        CASE WHEN dd.d_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) AS c ON s.c_last_name = c.c_last_name
      AND s.c_last_name_null = c.c_last_name_null
      AND s.c_first_name = c.c_first_name
      AND s.c_first_name_null = c.c_first_name_null
      AND s.d_date = c.d_date
      AND s.d_date_null = c.d_date_null
INNER JOIN (

        COALESCE(dd.d_date, DATE '1900-01-01') AS d_date,

    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),

        COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
